task: Core #1186: protect existing Fresh Install PostgreSQL17 owner-owned public/private schema and catalog rows with native pg_dump and owner-key encrypted GitHub artifact; prove archive decrypt/restore, never run hosted DDL or expose credentials

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Database dump uses existing pinned Fresh Install repository secret only in isolated GitHub runner; never publish plaintext backup, password, encrypted archive without a private key or false hosted migration proof. Run pg_dump PG17 under TLS target-check and perform native pg_restore with original source schema before encrypted artifact upload; no managed DDL.

acceptanceCriteria: Fresh Install ref istjjkdcvsvilrycqecd, zero user/customer rows and known 175+2 legacy app tables confirmed read only immediately before dump; never operate on waterk-platform or staging.

Native PostgreSQL17 pg_dump reads all public/private application schema and rows using existing SHOPERATION_FRESH_INSTALL_DB_URL secret; validates explicit hostname/DB/username and TLS verify-full; zero external output of credentials.

One pg_dump -Fc custom archive is parsed by native pg_restore --list and its data is rehydrated into separately sourced local PG17 legacy 0046 schema; verify 113 original neutral catalog rows, supported core table counts and original schema class.
Encrypt archive with AES-256-GCM CMS and owner-held 3072-bit RSA public certificate; test encryption/decryption locally before exposure; no private key committed, uploaded or stored in GitHub.
Upload only encrypted backup (and manifest with non-sensitive counts/digests) as a retention-limited GitHub artifact; no plaintext backup artifact even if steps fail.
Never deploy reviewed 31 SQL migrations until backup archive, its decryption and restoration evidence are verified; do not modify Supabase schema or migration ledger in this unit.
invariants: Original application schema and customer data never mutated by backup job.
No GitHub Actions secret may be echoed, logged, uploaded, or written to repo.
Private key stays only in owner-controlled user-download artifact and never in GitHub/CI logs.
Stop on any wrong target URL, server peer, PgMajor, TLS check, user data drift, schema source drift or restore failure.
Never claim a backend-provider-auth/storage full cluster backup from pg_dump scoped public/private.
Never run hosted DB DDL, reset, staging resume, new Supabase project or Vercel deployment.
forbiddenStates: Plaintext dump in public repository or Actions artifacts.
Encrypted artifact uploaded even though native pg_restore fails or source ref differs.
Private key shared to GitHub Actions or committed to git.
A source-only or pg_restore list-only result described as completed restoration.
Rerun on any non-Fresh Install target or production DB.
Any of 31 customer baseline Office migrations applied before verified recovery.

failureModes: Existing GitHub Actions database URL secret is missing, stale or references non-Fresh-Install project.
TLS verification fails with pooler host/certificate mismatch or obsolete credentials.
GitHub runner uses unsupported pg_dump older than DB server major17.
A public Actions artifact contains an unencrypted `.dump` file.
An encrypted archive exists, but 0046 replay cannot restore its data or match row counts.
The public GitHub workflow accidentally logs the database URL or private key.
Backup captures app public/private but user assumes provider-managed auth/storage schemas are restored.
Source drift occurs between preflight and dump or after backup and before migration.
edgeCases: URL direct host versus eu-central-1 pooler variant and query-string sslmode handling.
TLS root CA bundle inside postgres17 Docker image.
Connection URL punctuation and special characters must never be string-concatenated in printed commands.
Postgres managed extensions not installed in isolated restore fixture; native data replay required against 0046 source-created objects.
No customer/auth users and zero storage objects, but 113 neutral catalog rows require exact rehydration.
Failure before encryption must not publish plaintext tar or dump artifacts.
GitHub Actions artifact expires; owner must securely retain the encrypted artifact and the offline private key.
Recovering provider-owned auth/storage buckets needs separate recovery procedure.

alternatives.summary: Encrypt native pg_dump with owner-public certificate, native restore test, upload only ciphertext from Actions.
alternatives.reason: Existing GH Actions secret can reach Fresh Install, and owner never discloses private key to repo or runner.

alternatives.summary: Upload raw pg_dump as public repository GitHub artifact.
alternatives.reason: Would expose internal schema and potentially user or billing data to repository readers.

alternatives.summary: Assume Supabase Free tier has an automatable managed point-in-time restoration.
alternatives.reason: No verified managed backup API or restore point is available on selected free plan.

alternatives.summary: Replace native dump and replay with a read-only table count or handwritten INSERT statements.
alternatives.reason: It does not capture schema, access-control or data accurately enough to restore the database.

specialistReviews.finding: Even a disposable GitHub Action could leak sensitive data through job output or uploaded raw archives.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep the recipient private key offline, ensure only the owner-public X509 cert is committed, encrypt first, upload only ciphertext, and deny artifact path to raw data.

specialistReviews.finding: Successful `pg_dump` alone does not prove a restore is possible.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require native pg_restore rehydration to source-identical 0046 schema and actual row identity/count validation, not mere archive listing.

specialistReviews.finding: Provider snapshot is unavailable; logical public/private application dump is not the complete managed Supabase stack.
specialistReviews.resolution: Explicitly scope app-owned schema, provider-managed auth/storage out of scope, and keep 31 hosted migrations blocked until owner backup key and encrypted artifact delivered.

specialistReviews.finding: A stale or spoofed SHOPERATION_FRESH_INSTALL_DB_URL risks accessing a different database or a TLS-unauthenticated endpoint.
specialistReviews.resolution: Parse exact ref host/user/database and use PGSSLMODE=verify-full with trusted root, no inherited PG selectors and explicit server major checking before pg_dump.

challenge.resolution: Fail without artifacts, never substitute other database.

challenge.scenario: Secret points to waterk-platform or staging.
challenge.finding: Wrong tenant database target could be backed up or modified.
challenge.resolution: Strong URL parser rejects any other host or user.

challenge.scenario: A malicious or expired certificate weakens confidentiality.
challenge.resolution: Only fixed RSA3072 owner-public X509 certificate, CMS AES256-GCM and self-check; owner retains key.

challenge.scenario: Workflow uploads raw dump on error.
challenge.finding: Catastrophic disclosure for public GitHub repo.
challenge.resolution: Raw dump stays /tmp and upload step only accepts explicit ciphertext + safe metadata; no upload step uses if: always().

challenge.finding: Logical backup fails or is unreliable.
challenge.resolution: Run pinned postgres:17 client container and assert pg_dump major 17.

challenge.scenario: A `pg_restore --list` check passes but data cannot be restored.
challenge.resolution: Replay through PG17 local source schema and require exact neutral row counts.

challenge.scenario: Public/private archive lacks provider-managed auth session/Storage.
challenge.resolution: Explicit scope and validated zero auth users, 0 storage objects; separately note bucket/provider recovery limitations.

challenge.scenario: Backup is restored but GitHub artifacts expire before downloaded.
challenge.finding: No usable recovery artifact at release.
challenge.resolution: Short retention and require user download both encrypted archive and separate private key before hosted migrations.

proofPlan: Run critical canonical Development Guard for bounded CI workflow and documentation; record exact guard digest and all 46 matching Known Failures.

Verify encryption CMS AES256-GCM with offline private key, ship only owner-public X509 certificate and never commit private material.
Live workflow accepts only exact Fresh Install secret and TLS verified endpoint and authentic PostgreSQL17, with read-only preflight, native pg_dump and archive inspect.
Use isolated Docker PostgreSQL17 and existing source-pinned 0046 fixture bootstrap, restore original schema's data from backup and validate seven neutral catalogs.
Upload only cryptographically encrypted archive, download and decrypt offline, verify SHA and archives, and save report of actual restore evidence.
Run exact-head CI/Truth/Lifecycle, preserve issue #1186/#1228 OPEN and no hosted schema write/merge.
